name: goal-enforcement
description: Evidence-driven state and lifecycle guard for governed Codex project goals.

interface.shortDescription: Prevent premature mutations and completion in /goal workflows.
interface.longDescription: Goal Enforcement validates workspace-local goal state, blocks premature mutations and completion on hook-capable hosts, invalidates stale verification after changes, records failures, and provides an honest audit-only fallback on Windows.
defaultPrompt: Audit the active /goal state. Resolve the intended project workspace first; if the current directory has no .codex/goal-state.json, ask me for the workspace path before running the guard.
Explain why a /goal mutation was blocked
Check whether hard Hook enforcement is available
